title: New Japan vs. UWF: a battle of wrestling styles
summary: Returning UWF wrestlers challenge New Japan’s established stars with a different competitive identity. Inoki’s side and Akira Maeda’s group turn individual matches into a wider struggle between camps.

chapters.title: Inoki survives the elimination war
chapters.result: New Japan defeats UWF in a five-against-five elimination match.
chapters.context: Inoki eliminates Takada and Kido at the finish, allowing New Japan’s leader to stand as the final obstacle to the challengers.

chapters.title: UWF strikes back
chapters.result: The UWF team defeats a five-man New Japan team.
chapters.context: The return team battle keeps the outsiders credible and demonstrates that Inoki’s earlier win has not resolved the conflict.
